# Binding: model routing in this project

How this project applies [the routewise spec](spec/SPEC-model-routing.md) (section 9). The spec is never edited here. This file is rendered by `./install --project .` from the shipped roles and `[binding]` in `routewise.toml`; change those, not this file.

Approved by f0t0n (maintainer) on 2026-11-18 for rules spec version 4.

| Item | Value in this project |
|---|---|
| Where agent definitions live | Generated by `./install --project .` from `roles/`: `.claude/agents/` (cc), `.agents/agents/` (agy). Generated files are overwritten; to change a role, add a project role of your own under another name. |
| How tier and effort map to each harness's model setting | `harness.toml`, with overrides in `routewise.toml` `[tiers]`. Claude Code: `fast` → `haiku`, `balanced` → `sonnet`, `deep` → `opus`, `frontier` → `fable`. |
| Harnesses that cannot set a model per agent | agy: agents inherit the session model. |
| Built-in explorer to override (R-A3) | Claude Code `Explore`: the spec's `explorer` role ships as `roles/explore.md` with `name: Explore`, so it replaces the built-in agent. |
| Parallel cap (PA1) | `cap` in `routewise.toml` (default 5, the spec default). Raising it needs approval. |
| Miss log and command (M1) | `miss_log` in `routewise.toml`, written only by `bin/miss-log --project . add`; `bin/miss-log --project . report` prints the summary. |
| Where the instructions include the fragment | `instructions` in `routewise.toml` (default `AGENTS.md`), between the `routewise:start` and `routewise:end` markers. Claude Code reaches it through an `@AGENTS.md` import block in CLAUDE.md when needed (`claude_md`). |
| Assistant-mode reader delegation (A2) | None. |
| Assistant model and effort pins (A3) | Not an assistant project. |
| Miss-log review (M1) | First review on 2026-11-28, then monthly. |
| Findings caps | `reviewer` and `auditor` return every Critical and Required finding; only Optional and Nit are capped, at 5 (R-A2). |

Roles, as shipped (tier and effort; the spec's section 4 gives the reasons, and a role on `frontier` needs the approval above, section 12):

| Role | Tier and effort |
|---|---|
| `auditor` | `deep` at `high` |
| `Explore` | `fast` at the harness's default effort |
| `judge` | `frontier` at `medium` |
| `log-reader` | `fast` at the harness's default effort |
| `reviewer` | `balanced` at `medium` |
| `web-reader` | `fast` at the harness's default effort |
